purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Every object declares route, itinerary or combined-plan; the aggregate remains subject to a future split.
Journey execution, networks, places, services, schedules, resources, engines, datasets and evidence remain external masters.
Reusable route, computed route, itinerary, journey, line and journey pattern remain distinct.
Requested, applied and waived constraints and candidate, selected and confirmed states remain independent assertions.
OGC API Routes and Route Exchange Model are described as developing or proposed material, not approved standards.
Mode, jurisdiction, feasibility, privacy and external conformance profiles remain deferred.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The aggregate preserves stable identity, mandatory kind, endpoints or plan boundary, revision and successor lineage.
Topology, geometry, itinerary order, clocks, constraints and source profiles are separately represented.
Routing computation remains external while request parameters, result alternatives and decision lineage are retained.
A candidate or selected plan cannot prove feasibility, entitlement, legal permission, safety or actual execution.
Replanning appends successor state and differences without rewriting the prior plan or evidence.
Sensitive route and itinerary projections are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
Autonomous consequential rerouting, safety decisions, protected disclosure and irreversible destruction remain prohibited.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
